items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: I didn’t realize that your Claptons and whatnot had already done it to death since then

ctx.x: A handful of them. I mean we were like a covers band doing what we thought were obscure covers. We were trying not to be complete copyists. We’d do the lesser well known things that were standard. I can’t remember what we would have done now.

Actually I think I did things that I thought nobody had covered like “Further On Up the Road” by Bobby Bland. I didn’t realize that your Claptons and whatnot had already done it to death since then, which I thought that was an indication I was a good judge of a song, because I mean I found several, a long time ago sort of there was an Ivory Joe Hunter tune called “I Need You So” and I started doing that occasionally if we were busking. And I saw it on the arse end of a compilation of his stuff, thinking it was…
Did you feel compelled to try to re-create what you heard on these records as close as possible?
